product_context.primary_task: Identify and investigate wildfire risk around selected areas of interest
assumptions: Desktop analysis is the primary workflow
Map layers and evidence sources are available

archetype.rationale: The map is the primary spatial reasoning surface; evidence and time-series tools support investigation.
alternatives_rejected: Dashboard / Monitoring: map interaction is central, not secondary

regions.responsibility: Spatial analysis canvas with visible layer context
regions.notes: Dominant work surface; avoid decorative map chrome.

regions.responsibility: Select layers, time range, and filters
Inspect selected hotspot or area evidence
Show loading, source freshness, and errors

structural_changes: Map and inspector can be visible in parallel
Layer controls remain adjacent to map
Layer controls collapse into a dedicated control surface
Filters and feature details open as focused sheets

interaction_map.feedback: Announce active layer and loading state

decisions: Use map-first hierarchy rather than KPI-card dashboard
Show source freshness near evidence, not as a hidden tooltip

validation.task_clarity: Primary map investigation task is immediately apparent
validation.platform_fit: Uses web map interaction patterns and responsive inspector behavior
validation.accessibility_review: Provide keyboard feature selection, text alternatives, and non-color-only layer distinctions
unresolved_risks: Validate map performance with production-scale layers
